format: Makefile (specifically a kernel module build makefile with embedded definitions)
description: This file defines multiple kernel module packages related to virtualization support in the Linux kernel, including irqbypass, kvm-x86, kvm-intel, kvm-amd, vfio, vfio-pci, vhost, and vhost-net. It contains build instructions, dependencies, configuration options, and descriptions for each module, using makefile syntax with embedded define and eval calls.

classes.description: Supports hosting fully virtualized guest machines using hardware virtualization extensions.

classes.name: KernelPackage/kvm-intel
classes.description: KVM support for Intel processors with VT extensions.

classes.name: KernelPackage/kvm-amd
classes.description: KVM support for AMD processors with AMD-V extensions.
